response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, entry_count - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) AS diff_above_avg FROM per_race WHERE entry_count > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average entry count is the mean of the per-race entry counts over all races that have at least one constructorResults record and a matching race and circuit. Races with no entries are not counted as zeros.
Total points is SUM(points). SUM ignores NULLs, so missing points are ignored.
